capabilities: Track daily and weekly goals with status bar buttons
Increment or decrement goal progress via mouse clicks
Attach tasks to goals so completion adds points
Configure icons, colors, ordering, and reset frequency per goal
Store goal data in daily, weekly, or monday notes via frontmatter
extras: Goal data is written to note frontmatter, so values persist in the vault; the README ends with an issue link for bug reports and feature requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track recurring personal goals like exercise or reading counts from the status bar.
summary: Status bar plugin that adds clickable buttons for tracking daily and weekly goals, with progress bars and task-linked increments.
